articles.title: Khamenei’s Reluctant Approval Fuels Debate as U.S.-Iran Talks Begin
articles.summary: Iran’s supreme leader said he disagreed with the MoU but approved it anyway. Negotiators met in Switzerland Sunday, but hardliners are using state media to attack the deal, and a TV chief resigned after airing criticism.

articles.title: Abiy Ahmed’s Party Sweeps Election, But Tigray Tensions Loom
articles.summary: Ethiopia’s Prosperity Party won over 90% of seats, securing PM Abiy Ahmed another term. But analysts warn of renewed conflict after Tigray’s ruling party violated a 2022 peace deal, and elections were canceled there.

articles.title: Trump Blames Vandalism for Reflecting Pool Damage; Experts Point to Algae
articles.summary: President Trump claimed vandals slashed the Reflecting Pool’s lining and poured chemicals, leading to arrests. But scientists say the green water is a natural algae bloom, and law enforcement hasn’t confirmed any arrests.
